results.title: Onion Price Hike: Centre To Sell Rs 35/Kg Onions In 5 Cities Via ‘Kanda Express’ – Check Full List
results.description: Onion Price Hike: Onion prices have surged 59% in a year, prompting the Centre to move buffer stocks via Kanda Express from Nashik to five cities, where onions will sell at Rs 35 per kg. The post Onion Price Hike: Centre To Sell Rs 35/Kg Onions In 5 Cities Via ‘Kanda Express’ – Check Full List appeared first on The Sunday Guardian .
